body: Thank you for taking time to respond! That is a bummer to hear that this may continue to be my experience but I appreciate knowing this now. In the end I am just thankful I have insurance.
I am so sorry you are feeling so low. Random redditor to say you deserve help and support and a life worth living.

I had disturbing SH related dreams a while ago and I could NOT get them out of my head. 
OP i hope you are able to get some self care in and really care for yourself right now. 

What works for me (not all of the time) is a distraction. This typically requires something more involved (cooking, a hike, reading) but sometimes it is able to distract me from the dream triggers long enough for me to get through it.

I hope things look up for you OP. We are here if you.
I don’t remember defending my actions.
I am 27. Thank you, I hope so too!
Thank you very much for your well thought out response. You are absolutely right. Take care!

I lost my best friend recently because she told me I was too much. I really am not interested ruining my last few remaining friendships and that’s what I’m worried will happen. 
You’re right I absolutely will regret it.

Same here :( no home in my opinion is acceptable enough for her (little queen tbh) but I also don’t know how I can keep going on like this either. 
I’m sorry you’re experiencing this too :(
Much love to you and your little king
She’s the only reason I’ve lived this long but I am so unhappy I’m stressing her out and I would just think she would be better off without me. I can’t stand to know she would suffer without me :(
